Primary care

Your primary care clinician is your first call for almost anything: annual physicals, blood pressure and diabetes follow-ups, colds that won't clear, referrals and prescription renewals.

Who it's for
All ages
Visit types
In person or Video
Typical length
30 min

What to expect

  1. Before your visitFill in the health history form in the patient portal and bring a list of the medicines you take, including supplements.
  2. During the visitA medical assistant checks your vitals first. Your clinician then reviews concerns with you; there's time to ask questions.
  3. After the visitYour visit summary, lab orders and any referrals appear in the portal the same day.

What to bring

  • Photo ID and insurance card
  • List of current medicines
  • Questions you want answered

Questions

Do you take walk-ins?
Lab draws are walk-in during lab hours. For sick visits, book online; same-day slots open at 7:00 AM each weekday.
Can I see the same clinician every time?
Yes. You choose a primary care clinician and we book you with them whenever they're available.
Do you offer video visits?
Many follow-ups, behavioral health sessions and minor concerns can be handled by video. The booking form shows which visit types each service offers.
How do I cancel or move an appointment?
Use the link in your confirmation email or call the clinic. Please give 24 hours' notice so someone else can take the slot.
